documents.title: Generative AI Guidelines for Classroom Use
documents.quality_note: Recommendations to faculty to set GenAI expectations early; university-level guidance, not a binding policy.

documents.title: CDS Generative AI Assistance (GAIA) Policy
documents.quality_note: Unit-wide student-drafted policy: credit LLMs, appendix of exchanges, no LLMs in class tests.

notes: No CAS Computer Science department-level policy found beyond course syllabi (deferred: CS 111, CS 112, CS 391B from seed). BU SPH 'Artificial Intelligence Use' policy exists but is a public-health school, not computing, so not collected. Search snippets say BU has no university-wide AI policy; AIDA guidance is the closest.
